name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Responsiveness and date-handoff fix. Orbit now opens 5wCal immediately on a single tap, removing the former 400 ms Orbit-side wait. 5wCal uses a 550 ms double-tap window for reliable hardware recognition. A successful date double tap immediately calls back into Orbit state before any later return tap, so the selected day offset is already stored when the user goes back to Orbit. Selection success buzz is 120 ms. Orbit double-tap-to-settings is temporarily disabled in this isolation build.
